plan.name: Systematic Search Strategy
plan.strategy: Systematically search all possible storage locations for a clean egg and then place it in the microwave.
steps: Check the fridge 1 for a clean egg.
If not found, check the cabinets (cabinet 1 to 6) for a clean egg.
If not found, check the drawers (drawer 1 to 3) for a clean egg.
If found, pick up the egg.
Place the egg in the microwave 1.
